Name: Light Radius
Author: irocendar
Description:
Make in-game furniture and object lights cover a larger radius.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]How to use[/size]
Use Generic Mod Config Menu from the title screen or edit the config file to set how big furniture and/or object lights should be, as a multiple of their original size. The value '1' leaves them unchanged.

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6.
[*]Works in single player. Not tested in multiplayer yet.
[/list]
[size=5]See also[/size]

[list]

[/list]
